description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the Java application foundation to the latest supported framework baseline.
tasks.reason: Runtime and framework modernization is required before cloud-native migration tasks.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application to the latest supported Java framework and runtime baseline while preserving core fraud detection functionality.

tasks.description: Modernize application secret handling using Azure Key Vault.
tasks.reason: Cloud-native modernization requires secure centralized secret management.
tasks.requirements: Migrate plaintext and local credential usage to Azure Key Vault and align service authentication with managed identity where applicable.

tasks.description: Enable cloud-native database connectivity using managed identity.
tasks.reason: Moving to Azure-native service authentication removes password dependencies.
tasks.requirements: Modernize database connectivity to Azure SQL using managed identity authentication and preserve existing fraud data access flows.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in every modernization plan before deployment.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to patched versions, document major-version risk when required, and verify successful build and tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The requested end state includes Azure deployment with cloud-native operations.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the application to Azure Container Apps with production-ready configuration and managed identity-based access to dependent Azure services.
